spec.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && source /etc/network_turbo && export HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache && export HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET=1 && export REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt && export SSL_CERT_FILE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt && cd /root/contamcal-irt-calibration && python -c \"from datasets import load_dataset; load_dataset('openai/gsm8k', 'main', split='test', cache_dir='/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache'); print('GSM8K downloaded')\" && for bench in mmlu arc_challenge gsm8k; do echo \"===== Computing signals for \$bench =====\"; CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 python exp002/compute_signals.py --model-path /root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache/Falcon3-7B-Base --adapter-path /root/autodl-tmp/exp001/checkpoints/Falcon3-7B-Base_d100_s42/lora_adapter --benchmark \$bench --signal all --output-dir /root/autodl-tmp/exp002/signals/Falcon3-7B-Base_d100_s42/ --batch-size 4; done"
